name: Theldurin the Lost
summary: In the Badlands, the Twilight's Hammer hunts for Theldurin the Lost and the scroll of Myzrael he took when he fled.

sections.title: The Man Who Stole the Scroll
sections.body: Theldurin once followed the Twilight's Hammer. Then his mind slipped, and he turned from its teachings. He fled with the scroll of Myzrael, and the order could not catch him.

sections.title: Rumors of the Badlands
sections.body: Word has reached the Twilight's Hammer that Theldurin hides in the Badlands, raving and mad. The order needs the scroll for the Lady's return. First, you must find the man who took it.

faq.answer: Theldurin the Lost once followed the Twilight's Hammer. After his mind slipped, he rejected its teachings and fled with the scroll of Myzrael.

faq.q: Why is the Twilight's Hammer looking for him?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer seeks Theldurin because he fled with the scroll of Myzrael. The order says it needs the scroll to bring the Lady back.

faq.q: Where did Theldurin flee after leaving the order?
faq.answer: Rumors place Theldurin in the Badlands, though the Twilight's Hammer is not certain where he is.
